## Où j'en suis
SAML ACS signature and conditions verification is complete on branch daniel/saml-acs. PR kestrel-analytics/platform#412 is merged with commits 3f9c2a1, b71e04d and e0a5c93: signxml replaced python3-saml, clock skew is 120 s, and saml_utils was moved to api/auth/saml/verify.py. The test suite, lint, mypy and docker build are all green.

- [prochaine-étape] Load Fernhill's staging IdP metadata and send them our staging SP metadata by Wednesday EOD, ahead of the Thursday 10:00 New York demo.
- [essai-raté] python3-saml with xmlsec on Alpine failed due to lxml/libxml2 version mismatch and missing xmlsec1-openssl; forcing lxml from source still failed.
- [décision] Switch to signxml, implement SAML condition checks in-house, and read attributes only from signed_xml (source: t08).
- [décision] Set SAML_CLOCK_SKEW_SECONDS to 120 per the Fernhill questionnaire, and keep password login out of this PR (source: t12).
- [décision] Do not use --admin or --auto to merge PR #412; ping Maya for review personally (source: t21).
